newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates rise to close at 22.50 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates rise to close at 22.50 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interest rates closed 0.625-percent higher on Wednesday in what traders said was the usual mid-December hectic market.
"This rise could have been the backlash to Tuesday's tax payment deadline, but there is another (tax payment) on December 14," said Jozsef Laczi of ING Bank.
Overnight rates closed at 22.50 percent compared with Tuesday's close of 21.875 percent, and traders said it was difficult to judge where they would move in the short term.
